Bio7 4.0 API

    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Bio7Action
    This class provides some static methods to access some internal Bio7 methods.
    Bio7Dialog
    This class provides some default dialogs for the Bio7 application.
    Bio7Grid
    This class gives access to the Table component (based on the Nebula Grid Widget) of Bio7.
    Clipping
    Clipping of the volume and the iso surface in the 3D view (to make the interior visible): A clipping box: the parts outside of the box are removed (relative positions 0 - 1 in the extent of the displayed data). A free cutting plane (azimuth, elevation and offset).
    Clipping.Mask
    The removed voxels (immutable).
    Clipping.MeasureToolListener
    The listener of the measurement tools: the mouse events with the window position (pixels of the OpenGL surface, y from the top) and the view ray through the data (relative positions, start and end, or null outside).
    Clipping.Region
    The region of the clipping (the kept side of the box and the plane and the kept voxels of the mask) for relative positions (0 - 1, y = 0 is the first row like in ImageJ).
    Compiled
    This class provides some static methods for the access of the compiled classes of the Bio7 application.
    CoordinateTransform
    A transformation of coordinates between two coordinate systems (OGRCoordinateTransformation).
    CustomView
    This class provides some static methods for the creation of custom views inside the Bio7 application.
    DynamicLayer
     
    ExecuteRScript
     
    Feature
    A feature of a vector layer: its id, attributes (Long, Double or String values, null if not set) and geometry (WKT, null without geometry).
    FieldType
    The types of the attribute fields of vector layers (OGRFieldType).
    FileRoot
    This class provides static methods to get the Workspace, R, OpenOffice and script path location of the Bio7 application.
    Gdal
    GDAL for Java: the GDAL library of an installation (conda, Homebrew, the packages of Linux, QGIS, OSGeo4W) called with the Foreign Function and Memory API (Java 22+; no JNI library, no compiled code).
    GdalBand
    A band of a raster dataset: its pixels as Java arrays (row by row, the first row is the top), the no data value, the color table and the statistics.
    GdalDataset
    A dataset of GDAL: a raster (bands of pixels with georeferencing) and/or vector layers.
    GdalDataType
    The data types of the pixels of GDAL (GDALDataType).
    GdalDriver
    A driver (format) of GDAL.
    GdalException
    An error of GDAL (the message of GDAL) or of the bridge (e.g., GDAL is not loaded).
    GdalImageJ
    GDAL and ImageJ: rasters of all formats of GDAL as ImageJ images (with the georeferencing as calibration and properties), ImageJ images as GeoTIFF, the vectors of GDAL as ROIs of an image.
    GdalWorldWind
    GDAL and WorldWind: rasters of all formats of GDAL as image layers (reprojected to WGS84 by GDAL, the area outside of the data transparent), vectors as surface shapes and placemarks.
    GdalWorldWind.Raster
    The image and its sector (WGS84) of a raster.
    Geometry
    A geometry with its coordinates (parsed from WKT): points, line strings and polygons (also multi geometries and collections).
    GeometryType
    The geometry types of vector layers (OGRwkbGeometryType, 2D).
    HtmlSimulation
    Exports an interactive simulation to an HTML page (a single file without dependencies, WebGL for 3D): Play/Pause, Step, Reset, the speed and controls for the settings (sliders, number fields, text fields, check boxes, choices and buttons) with a 2D grid view (e.g., a cellular automaton), a 3D view (e.g., agents of a swarm model) or a dynamic 3D surface and an optional chart of values over time.
    HtmlSimulation.View
    The view of the simulation.
    IJTranserResultsTable
     
    ImageMethods
     
    IsoSurface
    Creates and renders an iso surface of an ImageJ stack.
    Measurement3d
    Measurements of the iso surface and the volume in the 3D view.
    Model
    This is the superclass for the dynamic compiled Java class! If the methods (below) are not implemented in the subclass (Model) the methods of this class are executed!
    OBJModel
    A model of an OBJ file (with the materials and textures of the MTL file), centered and scaled to a size.
    Plot3D
    A simple API to create 3D plots in the 3D view (the space view) without OpenGL code: the data of one or more plot layers (scatter, line, filled line, surface, wireframe, bars, contour, pie and the charts line graph, box plot, violin plot, histogram, area, radar, rose and treemap, see PlotCharts) with a title, axis titles, log axes, number formats, a legend and a color bar.
    Plot3D.Bars
    Bars (boxes) from the floor (or 0) to the values.
    Plot3D.Contour
    The contour lines of a grid (at their heights or on the floor).
    Plot3D.FilledLine
    A line filled down to the floor (a ribbon).
    Plot3D.Layer<T>
    A layer of a plot with the common settings: a label (for the legend), a color, a color map and the transparency.
    Plot3D.Line
    A line through the points.
    Plot3D.Pie
    A 3D pie chart (without axes, the labels in the legend and the percentages at the slices).
    Plot3D.Scatter
    A scatter plot: spheres at the points.
    Plot3D.Surface
    A surface of a grid (smooth shading, optional with the lines of the grid).
    Plot3D.Wireframe
    A wireframe of a grid.
    PlotLegend
    A legend of the 3D view (see SpatialUtil.setLegend and SpatialUtil.setColorBar): the labels with the colors of categories (e.g., the groups of a scatter plot) or a color bar of a continuous color ramp with the numbers of the values (e.g., the heights of a surface).
    PlotRecorder
    Records a plot of the plot API (see Plot3D) frame by frame, e.g., a plot which is updated in each step of a simulation (see Plot3D.update), and exports the recording to an HTML page with WebGL: the plot with the axes, the title and the legends of each frame, Play/Pause, a timeline, the speed and a loop (the view can be rotated and zoomed while the recording plays) or for Blender as an animation (see exportBlender).
    PlotTable
    The data of the active sheet of the Bio7 table for plots (see Plot3D): the columns as numbers or texts and a dialog to select the columns of the roles of a plot (e.g., X, Y, Z and an optional group).
    PlotTable.Options
    The settings of the plot of the dialog: the title, the axis titles and the logarithmic axes (null for a plot without axes, e.g., a pie chart), the color map and the export action.
    PlotTable.Selection
    The selected columns of the roles of a plot.
    PySession
    An embedded CPython in the Java process (Foreign Function and Memory API): one per process, it can't be stopped and started again.
    PythonCalls
    The functions of Bio7 for the embedded Python (the module bio7): the data of ImageJ and R.
    PythonCalls.Function
    A function for Python: string arguments and an optional value.
    PythonUtil
    The API of the embedded Python of Bio7 for Java, Groovy and BeanShell scripts (as REval for R; Python scripts use the module bio7).
    PyValue
    A value exchanged with Python.
    PyValue.Array
    A numeric or boolean array.
    PyValue.Frame
    A table (a pandas DataFrame): the columns by name (each an Array or Str) and the row labels (null for the default 0..n-1).
    PyValue.None
    None.
    PyValue.Other
    Any other object: its type and repr (not transferable).
    PyValue.PyDict
    A dict (the keys as strings, in their order).
    PyValue.PyList
    A list or tuple.
    PyValue.Str
    Strings (null elements are None in Python).
    RBackend
    The connection of Bio7 to R: embedded R, in the process of Bio7.
    RBridge
    The connection of Bio7 to R: embedded R in the process of Bio7.
    RException
    An error of R (the message of R) or of the embedded session.
    RScriptExecuter
     
    RScriptExecuterInterface
     
    RState
    A class to detect the R interpreter state (if a R job is running).
    RTable
     
    RTools
    This class provides methods for the communication with the R application.
    RTypeException
    Thrown when an R value is read as a type it can't be read as, e.g., doubles() of a function or firstString() of an empty vector.
    RUtil
    The API of the embedded R of Bio7 (the FFM bridge) for Java, Groovy and BeanShell scripts, as PythonUtil for Python.
    RValue
    An R object as Java data (a copy).
    RValue.Int
    An integer vector (also a factor: the codes with the attribute "levels").
    RValue.List
    A list (also a data frame: class "data.frame" with names and row.names).
    RValue.Logical
    A logical vector: 1 (TRUE), 0 (FALSE), NA_INTEGER (NA).
    RValue.Null
    NULL.
    RValue.Num
    A numeric (double) vector, a matrix with the attribute "dim".
    RValue.Other
    An object which is not transferred (e.g., a function or an environment): only its type.
    RValue.Raw
    A raw vector.
    RValue.Str
    A character vector (null is NA).
    ShellUtil
    A shell utility class which opens a terminal and starts a process with arguments.
    SimulationRecorder
    Records a simulation written in Java (e.g., a Bio7 model) step by step and exports it to an HTML page which plays the recording: Play/Pause, Step, Reset, the speed, a timeline to jump to a step, a loop and the chart (see HtmlSimulation for the views).
    SimulationRecorder.Frame
    The data of a step: the grid, the agents, the points, the lines, the surface and the chart values.
    SpatialCamera
    This class offers methods to adjust a custom camera and methods to get camera coordinates (walk-through camera).
    SpatialEvents
    This class offers static methods to detect custom mouse and key events in the Spatial panel of Bio7.
    SpatialLoader
    This is a utility class for Jogl (OpenGL) to load and create models and textures.
    SpatialMath
    This class offers some utility math methods.
    SpatialPicking
    Picks the object under the mouse in the 3D view (the selection mode of OpenGL): the objects are drawn between startPicking and endPicking with a name (glPushName / glPopName), getSelection returns the name of the nearest object at the mouse position.
    SpatialReference
    A coordinate reference system of GDAL (OGRSpatialReference).
    SpatialUtil
    A class which offers some custom methods for the Spatial view.
    Time
    This class provides methods to access the time and the counter of the Bio7 application.
    ValueSelection
    The values of a stack which are displayed as a volume or an iso surface: all values (the default), a range of values (e.g., the threshold of the image in ImageJ: only the particles) or a list of values (the labels of a segmentation).
    VectorLayer
    A vector layer of a dataset (OGRLayer): its fields, features, extent and coordinate system; filters (attributes, extent); new fields and features (a layer of a dataset created or opened for writing).
    VolumeRenderer
    Renders an ImageJ stack as a volume with a 3D texture.
    Work
    This class offers some methods for the control of the views, perspectives and the editor area of the Bio7 application.
    WorldWindView
     
    Ww
    This class gives access to the WorldWind GLCanvas.
